papers.title_en: FORGE: Feasible Online Reduced-Order Reference Generation and Whole-Body Execution for Agile Humanoid Locomotion
papers.authors: Adrian B. Ghansah, Yujin An, Jeeseop Kim, Soon-Jo Chung
papers.evidence: 面向敏捷人形机器人运动控制的两阶段学习框架
papers.tldr: 人形机器人敏捷运动需在宽指令空间生成可行参考并稳定全身跟踪。FORGE采用两阶段学习：先用单刚体动力学与全身运动学训练命令条件化降阶参考生成器，再冻结该策略在线生成参考，训练全阶全身跟踪策略。在Unitree G1上实现-2.0至2.8 m/s纵向、±1.0 m/s横向、±3.0 rad/s角速度运动、单腿跳及连续切换，且仅用统一参考与跟踪策略。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a two-stage learning framework for versatile and agile humanoid locomotion that couples online reduced-order model (ROM) reference generation with whole-body tracking control. In the first stage, we train a command-conditioned whole-body reference generator using single rigid body dynamics combined with full humanoid kinematics. In the second stage, the frozen ROM policy is rolled out online to generate references for training a whole-body tracking policy on the full-order dynamics model. Learning a kino-dynamically consistent reference generator in the simplified ROM space enables us to generate references over a broad command space and over multiple locomotion strategies using a single unified framework. We demonstrate the approach on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, achieving longitudinal velocities from -2.0 m/s to 2.8 m/s, lateral velocities up to +-1.0 m/s, angular velocities up to +-3.0 rad/s, one-legged hopping, and continuous transitions across the commands, all using one unified reference policy and one whole-body tracking policy.

papers.title_en: Data-driven Random-feature Approximation of Koopman Generators of Nonlinear Continuous-time Systems
papers.authors: Ana Čukarska, Maximilian Gollwitzer, Viola Muning Li, Vladyslav Fediukov, Zahra Monfared, Felix Dietrich
papers.evidence: 数据驱动的Koopman生成器随机特征逼近
papers.tldr: 针对非线性连续时间系统从数据学习困难、Koopman生成元数值近似依赖字典选择的问题，提出数据驱动的随机特征方法，为gEDMD等Galerkin近似构造简洁有效的函数表示。该方法利用数据信息改进与数据无关的字典，提升预测与系统分析效率。实验表明精度较高且快于迭代优化，并证明向量场与轨迹收敛。还给出gEDMD半群收敛判据及指数有界性反例，推动可解释且稳健的连续时间动力学建模。
papers.abstract_en: Learning continuous-time dynamical systems from data is an active area of research. The Koopman formalism is often used here, because it is a flexible approach that is informative about the system's fundamental properties. The formalism represents dynamical systems through linear operators acting on a suitable function space. A practical difficulty arising in the numerical approximation of Koopman operators is the choice of a ``dictionary'', meaning an effective finite-dimensional representation of the function space. In this paper, we focus on learning dynamical systems in continuous-time, and so we consider numerical approximations of the Koopman generator instead of the Koopman operator. Our main contribution is a data-driven random-feature method to obtain a parsimonious and effective function representation for Galerkin approximation methods such as gEDMD. The representation we construct is data-informed, which allows us to improve upon data-agnostic methods. We empirically demonstrate the suitability of our method for forecasting tasks and system analysis. The numerical experiments show that our approach is accurate, and faster than iterative optimization. Further, we prove convergence of our approximation of the vector field and the resulting trajectories. In addition to the numerical results, we also make theoretical contributions, including a general convergence criterion for the semigroup generated by the gEDMD approximation and a counterexample showing that gEDMD does not generally preserve exponential boundedness. With our contribution, we advance the frontier of efficiently learning continuous-time dynamics from data, towards interpretable and mathematically robust modelling based on the Koopman framework.

papers.title_en: LocoManiLab: A Unified Testbed for Data, Policies, Controllers, and Deployment in Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Dewei Wang, Jinrui Han, Jiyuan Shi, Chenyun Zhang, Xianbo Lu, Jiabao Wu, Jiqin Feng, Jipeng Kong, Ping Luo, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li
papers.evidence: 人形机器人移动-操作的策略、控制器与部署统一测试平台
papers.tldr: 人形机器人移动操作缺乏统一评估基准，策略、控制器与任务设置差异使进展难以比较。LocoManiLab整合数据采集生成、策略训练评估与物理部署，覆盖234个任务、五类家庭场景和51.5小时仿真遥操作。实验评估十二种策略及多控制器与扰动条件，揭示未见任务场景成功率下降、视觉扰动下鲁棒性差异。三个仿真任务与真实设置接近且策略排名一致，支持仿真评估可靠性并推动数据生成与部署闭环。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation in everyday environments, yet progress is difficult to assess across differing policies, controllers, and task settings. LocoManiLab provides an integrated testbed spanning data collection and generation, policy training, evaluation, and physical deployment. Its task suite covers 234 atomic and compositional tasks across five household scene categories, supported by 51.5 hours of simulated teleoperation. The evaluation covers twelve policies with a shared controller across task and scene splits and perturbation levels, two policies across five controllers, and studies of demonstration scale and data-source mixtures. Success rates fall on unseen tasks and scenes and generally decline as visual perturbations increase, with differences in generalization and robustness across policies. For data generation, a humanoid motion generation model is fine-tuned for loco-manipulation to study the alignment of its outputs with task execution requirements and its integration into the data generation pipeline. Three simulated loco-manipulation tasks closely match real-world setups, enabling evaluation of three policies in both domains. Similar policy rankings support the reliability of simulation-based evaluation.

papers.title_en: Zero-HLM: Generalizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation without Real Robot Data
papers.authors: Dianyi Yang, Mengya Liu, Zhumei Wang, Yu Liu, Xiaochen Zhang, Yixuan Li, Le Ma, Yuhang Yang, Weiqi Huang, Wei Liang, Baoxiong Jia, Siyuan Huang
papers.evidence: 实到仿到实管线在仿真中生成物理验证的人形示范
papers.tldr: 真实机器人数据昂贵，使人形全身移动操作难以泛化。Zero-HLM构建真实到仿真再到真实的框架，用手机拍摄与仿真源演示生成可执行全身动作，并通过高斯引导重建和运动-环境协同适配修正场景与参考。它生成4800条物理验证演示，在Unitree G1三项任务上实现零样本迁移，仿真训练GR00T N1.7平均全任务成功率达66.7%，高于真实数据训练的46.7%。扩展仿真训练还将泛化配置汇总成功率从23%提升到69%，无需额外真实演示。
papers.abstract_en: Learning generalizable humanoid loco-manipulation remains bottlenecked by costly real-world demonstrations. Simulation provides a scalable alternative, but requires visually faithful, physics-ready scenes and executable whole-body motions. We present Zero-HLM, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that transforms smartphone captures and simulated source demonstrations into scalable training data for humanoid loco-manipulation. Gaussian-guided agentic real-to-sim reconstruction aligns visual and physical scenes; motion-environment co-adaptation uses rollout feedback to correct whole-body references and interaction geometry. We generate 4,800 physically validated demonstrations for zero-shot transfer across three Unitree G1 tasks. Simulation-trained GR00T N1.7 achieves 66.7% mean full-task success, versus 46.7% with real-data training. On generalized configurations, expanded simulation training raises pooled success from 23% for base-trained real-data policies to 69%, without additional real demonstrations. Project page: https://young-bit.github.io/zero-hlm/

papers.title_en: Convex-SKM-Net: Low-Latency Block Halfspace Corrections for Neural Convex Constraint Satisfaction
papers.authors: Haoyu Zhu, Xiaochen Zhang, Qingchun Hou
papers.evidence: 用于决策的可微凸约束满足层
papers.tldr: 现有学习决策方法依赖约束专用投影或可行集参数化，迭代修复代价高，难以兼顾快速推理与严格约束满足。Convex-SKM-Net 提出凸约束满足层，用残差与次梯度 oracle 构造线性化半空间，并以固定深度对偶投影梯度下降求解最小位移块问题，同时联合学习预测器与正定 mobility。在 SOC-MPC 与电力系统凸松弛上，输出均满足 1e-3 可行性，推理最高加速 144.3 倍；QCQP 平均目标间隙 0.012%。该工作为低延迟、严格可行的神经约束满足提供了可证明收敛的新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Fast inference and strict constraint satisfaction are essential for learning-based decision-making. Existing methods often rely on constraint-specific projections or feasible-set parameterizations, while iterative repair can be costly. We introduce Convex-SKM-Net, a convex constraint-satisfaction layer that forms linearization halfspaces from residual and (sub)gradient oracles without constraint-specific inequality projectors. It applies fixed-depth dual projected-gradient descent (dual PGD) to minimum-displacement block problems using GPU-friendly matrix operations. We jointly learn the predictor and a positive-definite mobility, adapting the correction geometry to improve objective quality. We prove convergence of the outer iterates at fixed dual depth and linear convergence in distance under Slater's condition and bounded subgradients. All our test outputs on three second-order-cone model-predictive control (SOC-MPC) horizons and six power-system convex relaxations satisfy a $10^{-3}$ feasibility tolerance. Comparisons with the latest constraint-satisfaction methods show inference speedups of up to $144.3\times$ on SOC-MPC and $7.7\times$ on a convex quadratically constrained quadratic programming (QCQP) benchmark with joint training. On QCQP, the mean objective gap is $0.012\%$, with full test feasibility at $10^{-4}$. Learning mobility reduces the five-seed affine-task mean gap by $22.4\%$ and improves gaps in matched power-system comparisons.

papers.title_en: ConvRoute-ViT: Convolutional Token Routing for Efficient Vision Transformers
papers.authors: Manish Das, Shiv Ram Dubey, Satish Kumar Singh
papers.evidence: 用于高效视觉Transformer结构的卷积令牌路由
papers.tldr: 视觉Transformer的自注意力随token数量二次增长，且各层对所有patch token同等对待，带来冗余计算并分散对判别区域的关注。ConvRoute-ViT提出卷积式token路由：在选定层依据class-token注意力保留关键patch token，并将其余token空间重组、压缩为卷积摘要token，从而缩短序列而不完全丢失上下文。分层路由进一步为深层构建紧凑且具判别性的表示。CIFAR-100和TinyImageNet实验显示，它在保持分类精度的同时提升计算效率。
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong image recognition performance, but their self-attention increases quadratically with the number of input tokens and makes them computationally expensive. The standard implementation of ViT models treats all patch tokens with equal importance across every layer of the model. This uniform treatment introduces redundant computation and may reduce the model's focus on the most discriminative object regions. In this paper, we propose ConvRoute-ViT, a convolutional token routing mechanism for efficient vision transformers that performs token reduction through convolutional routing. Our model preserves the most relevant patch tokens according to class-token attention at selected layers, while the remaining tokens are spatially reorganized and compressed into a compact set of convolutional summary tokens. This design reduces the sequence length without completely removing the contextual information of the less informative tokens. By applying the routing process hierarchically, the proposed framework constructs compact and discriminative representations for deeper layers. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet show that ConvRoute-ViT improves computational efficiency while maintaining classification accuracy compared with the base ViT.

papers.title_en: Safe Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning: Zero Constraint Violation and Primal-Averaging Convergence
papers.authors: Chenxi Li, Yao Shu, Siyang Gao, Shuang Qiu, Guangxin Jiang
papers.evidence: 保证学习全程零约束违反的安全多目标强化学习
papers.tldr: 多目标强化学习常需在冲突目标间权衡并满足安全约束，但未知动力学下安全探索仍是难题。论文将乐观奖励估计与悲观成本界结合，确保累计与逐步约束在学习全程零违反。给定偏好时，算法用平均占用测度导出安全Markov策略，在平滑Tchebycheff标量化下达到O~(1/√T)次优间隙。作者还提出无偏好安全探索再规划算法，并给出首个逐执行策略安全的样本高效MORL保证。
papers.abstract_en: Many applications of multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) require policies that balance conflicting objectives while satisfying safety constraints. We study safe MORL with zero constraint violation throughout learning, covering both cumulative and stepwise constraints. A key challenge is to explore sufficiently under unknown dynamics and constraint costs without violating the constraints. For a given preference over objectives, we develop an algorithm to learn a safe Pareto optimal policy by combining optimistic reward estimates with pessimistic cost bounds. With high probability, every policy executed over $T$ episodes incurs zero constraint violation. The algorithm returns a safe Markov policy induced by the averaged occupancy measure and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ suboptimality gap under smooth Tchebycheff scalarization. We further develop a preference-free algorithm that first explores safely without a prespecified preference and then computes a safe policy for any given preference without further interaction. Over $T$ exploration episodes and $K$ planning iterations, it retains the same safety guarantee and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T}+1/\sqrt{K})$ suboptimality gap. Both algorithms require knowledge of a policy that strictly satisfies the constraints and its costs. We then relax these requirements, incurring at most constant cumulative violation. To our knowledge, we provide the first sample-efficient MORL algorithms that guarantee safety for every executed policy.

papers.title_en: Humanoid Dodgeball: Learning Fast Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance Motions for Humanoids
papers.authors: Aoqian Zhang, Chunzheng Wang, Haoran Chen, Annan Tang, Cheng Xiang, Fan Shi, Shuzhi Sam Ge
papers.evidence: 用于人形机器人敏捷全身避障运动控制的强化学习
papers.tldr: 人形机器人在动态环境中需快速躲避高速障碍并保持全身稳定，但高维动力学使避障、自然性与鲁棒性难以兼顾。本文提出 Humanoid Dodgeball 强化学习框架，利用威胁感知奖励塑造引导快速全身闪避，并用多方向对抗运动先验约束动作稳定与多样。仿真和硬件实验显示，该方法在不同障碍速度和发射距离下显著提升动态避障表现，同时保持稳健、物理可行且类人的运动。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoids have become increasingly agile and capable in real-world environments. To operate safely in dynamic scenarios, they must rapidly evade fast-moving obstacles while maintaining stability and physically feasible whole-body motion. Learning such behaviors remains challenging due to the high-dimensional dynamics of humanoid systems and the need to jointly balance reactive obstacle avoidance, motion naturalness, and control robustness. In this work, we present Humanoid Dodgeball, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for agile dynamic obstacle avoidance in humanoids. Our method enables highly dynamic whole-body evasive maneuvers against incoming projectiles through threat-aware reward shaping, while multiple direction-specific adversarial motion priors regularize the learned behaviors toward stable and diverse human-like motions. Extensive simulation and hardware experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially improves dynamic obstacle avoidance performance across diverse obstacle speeds and launch distances, while preserving robust and physically plausible humanoid motions.

papers.title_en: A Behavioral approach to Constrained Linear Quadratic Control: Feasibility and Optimality
papers.authors: Soutrik Bandyopadhyay, Debasattam Pal, Shubhendu Bhasin
papers.evidence: 约束线性二次最优控制被表述为凸变分优化
papers.tldr: 针对受约束线性二次最优控制，经典状态-输入表述难以统一处理轨迹级约束，本文转向行为学框架。该方法用核表示描述系统动力学，以无限维凸锥上的行为不等式刻画约束，并用二次微分形式编码性能指标。由此把问题转化为轨迹上的凸变分优化，借助Gateaux微分导出平稳性与互补条件，并写成增广行为系统。进一步对自治与可控子行为作唯一分解，可完整参数化所有最优约束轨迹，形成行为版KKT框架并为闭环与数据驱动扩展奠基。
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a constrained linear-quadratic (LQ) optimal control framework within the behavioral approach. Unlike classical formulations that rely on state-input representations, our method treats both the system dynamics and the constraints as trajectory-level objects. The system is modeled through a kernel representation, while inequality constraints are captured using behavioral inequalities defined over infinite-dimensional convex cones. Using quadratic differential forms (QDFs) to encode performance indices, we formulate the constrained LQ problem as a convex variational optimization over trajectories. By employing Gateaux differentials, we derive the stationarity and complementarity conditions and show that they admit a representation as an augmented behavioral system whose unique decomposition into autonomous and controllable sub-behaviors yields a complete parameterization of all optimal constrained trajectories. The resulting conditions constitute a behavioral analogue of the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) framework. A numerical example illustrates the effect of inequality constraints on the optimal behavior. The framework provides a general, trajectory-level representation for constrained optimal control and opens avenues for closed-loop and data-driven extensions.

papers.title_en: Possibility-based Inference: A Deterministic Framework for Robust and Reliable Uncertainty Quantification in Decision-Making
papers.evidence: 面向不确定性下鲁棒决策的确定性不确定性量化
papers.tldr: 安全关键机器学习系统在不确定条件下决策时，需要可靠量化模型行为并评估其影响，但贝叶斯推断常受数据精度不足和性能-精度权衡制约。本文受模糊集理论启发并基于贝叶斯统计，提出可能性对比预测等级，用可能性表示替代潜在后验来完成参数估计与模型选择。该确定性框架能更灵活刻画不确定及冲突信息，系统化挖掘数据，并缓解高度专业化深度模型过度自信、不合理预测的问题。
papers.abstract_en: Decision-making under uncertainty remains a key issue in Machine Learning (ML), particularly in the deployment of safety-critical systems, where reliable quantification of system behavior is essential for evaluating behavioral impacts and strengthening confidence in ML models. This contribution, influenced by fuzzy set theory and grounded in Bayesian statistics, addresses challenges related to data precision and the performance-accuracy trade-off in Bayesian inference (BI). To this end, we introduce a possibility-based contrastive grade of prediction as an alternative quantification method to existing latent posterior-based approaches for parameter estimation (approximation) and model selection. Unlike conventional Bayesian inference, which represents uncertainty within the probabilistic framework, the proposed model adopts a possibility-based representation that allows uncertain and potentially conflicting information to be characterized more flexibly. Rather than focusing on isolated aspects of a problem, the resulting mathematical framework provides a systematic approach to data mining while mitigating overly confident, yet implausible predictions generated by highly specialized deep learning architectures.

papers.title_en: Learning Safe Flow Matching Robot Policies from Binary Feasibility Oracles
papers.authors: Jianming Ma, Rongjun Jin, Yizhi Chen, Yue Gao
papers.evidence: 在机器人策略优化中施加硬可行性约束
papers.tldr: 机器人基础模型常用流匹配生成操作动作，但生成动作未必满足关节限制与避碰等物理约束，且可行集往往只能通过黑盒二值可行性查询获得。本文提出 oracle 引导的可微安全防护机制，在前向用可行性查询修正不安全更新，在反向提取局部边界信息形成约束感知学习信号，并与离散时间流匹配统一用于训练和推理。障碍感知操作实验中实现100%约束满足，同时保持任务性能。该工作为仅有可行性 oracle 的安全机器人策略学习提供了无需显式约束模型的前后向对齐方案。
papers.abstract_en: Robot foundation models increasingly rely on flow-based action generation for general-purpose manipulation, yet the generated actions are not guaranteed to satisfy physical constraints such as joint limits and collision avoidance. This problem is especially challenging when the feasible set cannot be described analytically and is accessible only through black-box feasibility oracles. We study this practical oracle-only setting and propose an oracle-guided differentiable safeguard for safe flow-matching robot policies. The safeguard uses binary feasibility queries to correct unsafe updates in the forward pass, while extracting local boundary information to provide constraint-aware learning signals in the backward pass. Combined with discrete-time flow matching, the same safeguard is used during training and inference, enabling forward--backward aligned policy learning without explicit or differentiable constraint models. Experiments on obstacle-aware robotic manipulation demonstrate 100% constraint satisfaction while preserving task performance.

papers.title_en: Gym-Anything for Robotics: Scaling physical simulations with digital agents
papers.evidence: 由编码智能体自动生成逼真机器人物理仿真的框架
papers.tldr: 机器人仿真本可支撑具身智能的大规模训练，但现有仿真覆盖的任务与物理现象很窄，且依赖专家手工构建、难以规模化。作者提出 Gym-Anything for Robotics，让编码智能体自动创建仿真，按美国 GDP 数据挑选有经济价值的物理工作，并用对抗式创建-审计循环把控仿真与任务质量，构建出含 25 个仿真、25 个测试与 175 个训练环境的 RoboWorld。最强前沿模型在全部测试任务上平均奖励仅 0.06，而上下文学习、特权教师、自辅助学习与代码策略生成示范均带来显著提升。框架、环境与基准全部开源。
papers.abstract_en: Realistic, fast robotics simulations could enable large-scale training of embodied AI models that transfer to the real world. However, despite decades of progress, available simulations cover only a narrow range of real-world tasks and physical phenomena. The core bottleneck is that creating better simulations requires significant expert effort and therefore does not scale. To address this, we introduce Gym-Anything for Robotics, a framework in which coding agents create realistic robotics simulations. Our core insight is that simulation creation is a coding agent task, so improvements in coding agents translate directly into richer and more faithful simulations. We select simulations based on U.S. GDP data to cover economically valuable physical work, define what makes a good simulation and a good task, and develop an adversarial creation-audit loop that checks each simulation and task against these definitions. Using this pipeline, we build RoboWorld, a set of 25 simulations with 25 test and 175 training RL environments of varying difficulty. Even the best frontier models fail on every RoboWorld test task, achieving an average reward of only 0.06. Building on RoboWorld, we introduce several new ways for frontier models to improve, including in-context learning across repeated attempts, a privileged teacher that reads the simulator state and teaches a student in context, self-assisted learning from the model's own privileged experience, and code policies that generate demonstrations across varied scenes to train vision-language-action models (VLAs) such as $π_{0.5}$. Each of these substantially improves performance. We release our pipeline, RL environments, and benchmark to facilitate future research. Code and data are available at https://gym-anything.github.io/robotics

papers.title_en: Active Reachability Learning for Humanoid Recoverability Monitoring
papers.authors: Zeyuan Feng, Baljeet Singh, Sarthak Ranjeet Kaingade, Somil Bansal, Bryan Trinh
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人策略部署的运行时可恢复性监测
papers.tldr: 人形机器人部署任务策略需要运行时监视器及时预判不可恢复的跌倒并触发回退，但现有方法假设训练数据天然覆盖可恢复性包络，接触丰富系统难以获取此类数据。本文提出统一框架，交替进行价值学习与主动探索，将数据探索重构为reach-avoid问题，由不确定性引导的探索器发现未见状态并避开确定不可恢复区域。在随机基准与29自由度Unitree G1上，监视器覆盖率与准确率大幅提升，并零样本迁移到真实硬件。
papers.abstract_en: Deploying humanoid task policies requires reliable runtime monitors that anticipate unrecoverable falls in time to trigger a fallback. We formulate this task as learning the stochastic, finite-horizon recoverability envelope of a given fallback policy. Synthesizing this monitor is challenging: existing methods assume training data naturally covers the recoverability envelope, yet acquiring such data remains a major bottleneck for contact-rich systems. Consequently, they recover only a fraction of the true envelope, leaving them prone to optimistic hallucinations for out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. We resolve this via a unified framework that iterates between value learning and active exploration. Data exploration is reframed as a reach-avoid problem, where an uncertainty-guided explorer systematically uncovers unseen states while avoiding confidently unrecoverable regions. This loop is further supported by a combined Temporal Difference and Monte Carlo objective for accurate in-distribution value prediction and reliable uncertainty estimation. By explicitly treating the remaining high-uncertainty regions as unrecoverable, the monitor mitigates optimistic OOD hallucinations. Evaluated on stochastic benchmarks and a 29-DoF Unitree G1 humanoid, our approach drastically improves monitor coverage and accuracy and successfully transfers zero-shot to real-world hardware.

papers.title_en: Multiscale Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.authors: Tao Ren, Hui Yang, Jia Deng, Tingyang Chen, Qiyao Wang, Shuo Tang, Ziyang Zeng, Yuhua Jiang, Guanghao Li, Huatong Song, Yining Li, Yifan Luo, Kunbao Ding, Feng Chang, Chuan Hao, Ran Tao, Bryan Dai, Jiafeng Liang, Jinyang Jiang
papers.evidence: 多尺度优势估计与策略优化
papers.tldr: 长程LLM智能体按完整助手回合与环境交互，却逐token生成动作，导致信用分配尺度错位。作者观察到critic价值主要在回合间变化，提出多尺度策略优化MPO，将多尺度优势估计与回合级重要性采样结合，在回合尺度对齐信用分配和策略更新。在搜索、工具使用和自动化任务上，4B与30B-A3B模型均稳定优于强RL基线。该工作为长程智能体强化学习提供了更匹配回合结构的优化思路。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents interact with their environments through complete assistant turns while generating each action token by token. We observe that critic values vary primarily across turns, motivating optimization anchored at turns with finer credit allocation among tokens. We propose Multiscale Policy Optimization (MPO), combining Multiscale Advantage Estimation (MAE) and turn-level importance sampling to align credit assignment and policy updates at the turn scale. Extensive experiments across search, tool-use, and automation tasks with 4B and 30B-A3B models demonstrate consistent gains over strong RL baselines.

papers.title_en: Remember Where You Walk: Learning Spatial Memory for End-to-End Legged Robot Exploration
papers.authors: Leon Magnus, Nico Bohlinger, Jan Peters, Oleg Arenz
papers.evidence: 面向足式与人形机器人强化学习导航的空间记忆网络结构
papers.tldr: 复杂环境中的足式机器人需记住已离开视野、稍后才相关的信息，但LSTM等端到端记忆网络难以长期保真。作者提出基于Hadamard记忆的局部空间矩阵记忆LSMM，将通用任务信息写入位置对应的记忆单元，实现空间落地的灵活记忆。在自主迷宫探索中，LSMM覆盖表现不逊于强循环与有限历史基线，且唯一能记住迷宫布局，重建误差降低三倍。该工作为足式机器人端到端探索提供了空间记忆架构。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoids and other legged robots operating in complex environments must remember information that leaves their field of view and only becomes relevant much later. Reinforcement learning policies address this using memory networks such as LSTMs that are trained end-to-end with the policy to memorize such task-relevant aspects. Yet, such architectures often fail to preserve sufficient information over long horizons. In this work, we propose a network architecture based on Hadamard memory that specifically targets robot navigation. Our Local Spatial Matrix Memory (LSMM) enables RL agents to store generic task-relevant information at specific, position-based memory cells, enabling flexible and spatially grounded memorization. We evaluate LSMM on the task of autonomous maze exploration, where it matches the maze coverage of strong recurrent and finite-history baselines while being the only architecture that remembers the maze layout, reducing the reconstruction error threefold.

papers.title_en: Echo: Scaling Visual Reinforcement Learning with Off-policy Experience
papers.evidence: 单阶段离策略强化学习与逆向蒸馏价值学习
papers.tldr: 视觉强化学习因渲染与策略推理开销大，扩展经验收集代价高昂，两阶段教师—学生蒸馏又会引入模仿差距。Echo提出单阶段离策略框架，用逆蒸馏让基于状态的辅助策略模仿视觉策略并采集无需渲染的经验，通过共享特权critic直接改进视觉策略。在三个运动任务与两个灵巧手任务上，相比基线将达标时间平均缩短60%和56%，峰值回报分别提升62%和12%。
papers.abstract_en: Scaling visual reinforcement learning (RL) with GPU-accelerated simulation is computationally expensive due to rendering and visual-policy inference costs. Consequently, two-stage teacher--student distillation is commonly used to train visual policies, but introduces an imitation gap. In this preliminary study, we introduce \echomethod{}, \textbf{a single-stage off-policy RL framework that scales experience collection without proportionally increasing visual computation}. Through \textbf{inverse distillation}, a state-based auxiliary policy imitates the evolving visual policy and collects inexpensive, unrendered experience. Echo leverages this experience for off-policy value learning, directly improving the visual policy through a shared privileged critic. We instantiate \echomethod{} with FastTD3 and evaluate it on three visual control tasks and two dexterous manipulation tasks in Genesis. Relative to \sdpgmethod{} under the evaluated configurations, Echo reduces time to reference returns by an average of \textbf{60\% across the three locomotion tasks} and \textbf{56\% across both hand tasks}, while improving peak mean returns by \textbf{62\% and 12\%}, respectively. Both hand tasks also achieve higher mean returns at matched simulator-transition budgets. These initial results suggest that scaling off-policy experience is a promising approach to efficient direct visual RL.

papers.title_en: Learning from Relative Action Credit for Escaping Local Minima
papers.authors: Giovanni Minelli, Giulio Turrisi, Lorenzo Amatucci, Victor Barasuol, Claudio Semini
papers.evidence: 扩展PPO的动作条件价值评论家改进信用分配
papers.tldr: 长时程接触丰富操作中，PPO等在线强化学习常因状态价值评论器缺乏动作区分而停滞于局部最优。本文为PPO加入动作条件价值评论器，在同一状态比较已执行动作与替代动作，并结合广义优势估计和探索噪声约束。实验显示该方法能跳出平台期，在PPO相同探索失败的训练预算内完成精密插销。其贡献是从相对动作信用分配角度解释并缓解局部最优。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning holds the promise of robots that learn manipulation skills from interaction alone, without pretrained priors or demonstration data. In practice, on-policy methods such as PPO routinely stall on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks: dense reward shaping carries the policy through stages, yet stitching them together and discovering sparsely rewarded events rarely succeeds. We trace this failure to the missing action discrimination in state-value credit assignment: a state-value critic judges progress only by episode outcomes, so when the policy converges to a partial solution all outcomes coincide, and improvement stops because no action can prove better than another. We therefore extend PPO with an action conditioned value critic which, can compare the executed action with alternatives sampled at the same state and aid the learning signal. Combined with Generalized Advantage Estimation and a bound on exploration noise, we show how the extended algorithm escapes the plateau and completes precise peg insertion within a training budget where PPO with identical exploration fails.

papers.title_en: CSO: Refining Robotic Policies via Skill Distribution Alignment and Skill-Grained Optimization
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Xiang, Xiang Deng, Wanjie Tao, Xu Chen, Zhao Jielun, Weili Guan
papers.evidence: 通过技能粒度强化学习优化机器人策略
papers.tldr: VQ-VAE等离散技能方法受量化误差影响，技能先验分布次优，直接强化学习微调还存在编码器更新不稳定与重要性采样粒度难题。CSO采用两阶段后训练：拒绝采样监督微调对齐观测到技能映射，冻结编码器后按完整技能计算裁剪重要性比并优化策略。轻量QueST策略在LIBERO上将成功率从80.1%提升至97.5%，RoboTwin2.0性能提升，五个真实单臂任务达61.0%。该工作为机器人策略细化提供了稳定高效的后训练方案。
papers.abstract_en: Discretizing continuous actions into discrete skills using methods like VQ-VAE has emerged as a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation. However, quantization errors yield a suboptimal distribution for the skill prior, degrading its performance. While reinforcement learning offers a path for refinement, its direct application faces unstable encoder updates and a granularity dilemma in importance sampling. To address these challenges, we introduce Cascaded Skills Optimization (CSO), a two-stage post-training framework. First, Rejection-Sampling Supervised Fine-tuning aligns the model's observation-to-skill mapping with the distribution of successful online trajectories via supervised fine-tuning. Second, with the observation encoder frozen, Skills Policy Optimization computes an independent, clipped importance ratio for each complete skill, enabling stable and efficient updates. With a lightweight QueST-style policy, CSO raises overall LIBERO success from 80.1% to 97.5%, improves performance on RoboTwin2.0, and achieves 61.0% success across five physical single-arm tasks. Additional comparisons with FAST, discrete BEAST, and fixed-buffer IQL further validate the effectiveness of our two-stage post-training strategy.
